infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: BirdDex uses your camera to photograph and identify bird species.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: BirdDex accesses your photo library so you can upload bird photos for identification.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: BirdDex saves bird photos to your library.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: BirdDex records the GPS location of your bird sightings so you can view them on a map.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: BirdDex may access the microphone when recording video of birds.
